Liver function tests not available – order ALT/AST before initiating atorvastatin.

treatment_summary: Continue lisinopril and hydrochlorothiazide for hypertension. Initiate atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for primary CVD prevention and metformin XR 500 mg nightly (titrating to 1 g BID) to reduce progression from prediabetes to diabetes. Offer semaglutide for weight loss if the patient wishes. Arrange baseline labs (eGFR, LFTs, lipid profile, iron studies) and calculate QRISK. Provide lifestyle referrals (diet, exercise, NHS Diabetes Prevention Programme) and monitor BP, lipids, HbA1c, renal function, and weight according to NICE schedules.
